capability.description: A deny-by-default grant of a specific API/data/orchestration right (ENT-22), optionally TTL'd.

action.description: The specific right within the domain (e.g. 'query', 'read', 'deploy', 'start_run', 'manage_users').

domain.description: The governance domain of the right.

expires_at.description: Optional TTL: the ISO-8601 UTC instant at/after which the capability is expired. Omitted means it never expires.

resource.description: A single node-owned object a grant names. The coarse tiers are database/project; the fine-grained object tiers (#747) are table/column/blob/tool, which add the optional `database` (table/column) and `columns` (column) fields.

columns.description: The granted column set, for the column kind.

database.description: The owning database, for the table/column kinds.

name.description: The object's handle: database/project name, table name (table/column), blob id-or-prefix, or MCP tool name.

scope.description: What the role permits — deny-by-default. A resource is in scope iff `unrestricted` is true or it appears in `grants`.

grants.description: The explicit in-scope resources. Order is preserved.

unrestricted.description: The '*' grant: when true the role reaches every resource.

scoped_grant.description: A specific right (operation) bound to a specific object (#747).

operation.description: The right this grant confers on the object.

description: A named permission set (FEAT-9 / #744): a Scope (which resources) + a CapabilitySet (which rights), granted to a user via UserRole. The on-disk role.json projection of the replicated `role:<uuid>` CRDT value. Mirrored by zetta::governance::Role in include/zetta/governance/role.hpp and enforced by role_permissions_from_json() + Node::load_roles()/reconcile_roles() — keep them in sync. The scope/capability sub-shapes mirror access_key.schema.json's $defs.

capabilities.description: The deny-by-default FLAT (unscoped) rights this role grants (ENT-22) — granted on every object. Optional; absent means no flat rights.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

id.description: The role's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in role.json and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

name.description: The role's name (unique among roles), e.g. a built-in 'admin'/'writer'/'reader'.

scoped_grants.description: Object-scoped grants (#747): rights bound to a specific object (table / column-set / blob prefix / MCP tool / database). Optional; absent means no object-scoped rights. Each narrows a permission to exactly the objects it covers.

title: Role
